app.name: GameCheck
app.tagline: Will it run on your PC?

common.notBuiltYet: This section is not built yet. Nothing on this page is interactive until its phase is done.

home.title: Welcome to GameCheck
home.intro: GameCheck reads your PC's real specs, finds the games installed on it and compares them with the requirements published on Steam.
home.statusBody: This is an early development build. The app shell, navigation and languages work; the features listed in each section arrive phase by phase.

store.description: Browse games and software from the Steam catalog, with images, prices, release dates and system requirements.
features: Search the whole Steam catalog by name, also offline
Games and software, free and paid, with genres and categories
Prices, currency and discounts for your region, with the time they were fetched
Minimum and recommended requirements
Open the game's page on Steam

library.description: Your games in one place: owned on Steam and installed from any launcher.
features: Connect Steam securely through Steam's own sign-in page
Owned and not-owned games, respecting your Steam privacy settings
Installed games from Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Battle.net and Microsoft Store
Add a game manually or hide one from the list without touching its files

myPc.description: Your hardware, read from Windows. Anything that cannot be read is shown as unavailable.
features: Processor, cores and threads
Memory, graphics card and video memory
Windows version, 32/64-bit, DirectX feature level
Drives and free space, display resolution
Installed programs, kept separate from games

compatibility.description: Compare a game's requirements with your PC, component by component.
features: Processor, memory, graphics card, Windows, DirectX and storage
A clear verdict: excellent, good, limited, not suitable or unknown
The component that limits you the most

performance.description: Real frame-rate measurements and settings suggestions. No invented FPS numbers.
features: Measure FPS on your own PC (optional, using Intel PresentMon)
Resolution (720p, 1080p, 1440p) and quality presets (Low to Ultra)
Settings suggestions, marked as general guidance unless confirmed for the game

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: The interface switches between right-to-left and left-to-right automatically.
settings.notInApp: Not running inside the GameCheck app
settings.disclaimer: GameCheck is not affiliated with Valve or Steam.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The error was written to the log file. Reloading usually fixes it.
